Echinopsis is a genus of cacti native to South America, sometimes known as hedgehog cactus , sea-urchin cactus or Easter lily cactus . As of November 2025 [update] , Plants of the World Online used a broad circumscription of the genus, resulting in about 80 accepted species, ranging from large and treelike types to small globose cacti. The name derives from echinos hedgehog or sea urchin , and opsis appearance, a reference to these plants' dense coverings of spines.
